method: MediaWiki parse + open_page of runescape.wiki perk articles; engine compared to in-game description / rank tables only (PvME not used as numeric authority)

results.wiki_text_excerpt: In-game description: Ability damage is increased by 6%, plus an additional 2% per rank, but prevents critically striking. (Cannot critically strike for 30s after unequipping this perk). Rank table: 1 +8%, 2 +10%, 3 +12%, 4 +14%. Max ancient rank 4. Reworked 30 March 2026 to 6% + 2%/rank (was 10% + 1%/rank).
results.engine_value: equilibriumDamageBonus(rank) = 0.06 + 0.02*rank → R1 0.08 … R4 0.14; equilibriumBlocksCrits(rank>=1); loadoutStats forces critChance=0 when equilibrium>0; max rank 4 in PerksPanel
results.action: none — formula, crit block, and max rank already match wiki (verifiedAt 2026-07-26)

results.wiki_text_excerpt: In-game description: +2% chance per rank to critically hit opponents. This perk has an increased chance to activate on level 20 items. Body: +2% crit (+2.2% on level 20 item) per rank. Rank table: R1 +2%(2.2%) … R4 +8%(8.8%). Does not affect damage-over-time abilities. Max ancient rank 4.
results.engine_value: bitingCritChanceBonus(rank, level20) = (level20 ? 0.022 : 0.02) * rank; loadoutStats adds to critChance when equilibrium is off

results.wiki_text_excerpt: In-game description: Ability damage is increased by 0.5% per rank. Body: AD multiplied by 1 + 0.005×R; affects DoTs, poison, conjures, Aftershock, Crackling, god books. Max ancient rank 4. Formerly named Equilibrium.
results.engine_value: eruptiveDamageBonus(rank) = 0.005 * rank; eruptivePerkModifier multiplies damage by 1+bonus

results.wiki_text_excerpt: In-game description: Ultimate abilities gain 3% + 1% base damage per rank. Rank table: 1 4%, 2 5%, 3 6%, 4 7%. Multiplicative; no effect on non-damaging ultimates (Berserk, Death's Swiftness, Living Death). Max ancient rank 4. Reworked 2 March 2026 from adrenaline cost reduction.

In-game description: The damage of Combust and Dismember is increased by 10% + an additional 3% per rank. Bounds multiplied by 1.1 + 0.03R. Rank table: 1 13%, 2 16%, 3 19%, 4 22%. Max ancient rank 4. Fragmentation Shot removed 2 March 2026.
results.engine_value: lungingPerkModifier: mult = 1 + (10+3*rank)/100 for dismember/combust (engine + record ids)

results.wiki_text_excerpt: In-game description: Gain by 50 + 25 per rank accuracy bonus. Rank table: 1 75, 2 100, 3 125, 4 150. Max ancient rank 4. Reworked 2 March 2026 from Slice/Piercing Shot/Wrack adrenaline tradeoff.
results.engine_value: energisingAccuracyBonus(rank) = 50 + 25*rank; loadoutStats adds to playerAccuracy for DP

results.wiki_text_excerpt: In-game description: Increases your minimum damage by 1.5% per rank of your maximum damage. Formula: newMin = min + r·1.5%·max. Max standard 5 / ancient 6. Does not affect most DoTs (except Bloat) or conjures.
results.engine_value: preciseMinHitAddition(maxDamage, rank) = 0.015 * rank * maxDamage; band-side helper only — not in loadoutStats cast pipeline (document-only path as designed)
results.action: none — documented helper; not wired into loadout cast modifiers by design

equilibriumCritZero.engine: critChance = 0 when loadout.perks.equilibrium > 0 (ignores biting/set crit bonuses)
